why: Fonts whose weight is only in the typographic subfamily name (id 17) get their real weight instead of 400: Open Sans Light 300, SemiBold 600, ExtraBold 800, Noto Sans CJK KR Bold 700. The .fixed files equal the old output except for those weights. The pending scenarios import OpenSans-ExtraBold renamed to Mig Fonts and record weight 400; they should record 800.
